# Google Translate for Antigravity An integrated, zero-token auxiliary side-panel plugin for Google Antigravity. Translate code comments, documentation, and arbitrary text directly inside the IDE workspace without context switching or third-party browser tabs.
--- ## Overview Working with multilingual documentation, foreign-language codebases, or prompt engineering across languages typically requires switching between your editor and external translation tools. This plugin embeds a lightweight Google Translate interface into Antigravity's auxiliary side panel. It operates as a local background process with instant translation, automatic language detection, and zero model token overhead. --- ## Key Features - **Zero Token Overhead:** Translations are processed directly through Google's public translation endpoints, avoiding AI model invocations and preserving your API quotas. - **Resilient Multi-Tier Fallback & Caching:** Multi-endpoint failover architecture with in-memory caching to eliminate rate limits (HTTP 429) and network drops. - **Minimal, Focused Interface:** Designed specifically for developer workflows with a clean dual-pane layout, character counting, and one-click clipboard copying. - **Automatic Language Detection:** Identifies source languages automatically as you type, supporting code comments, single terms, or multi-paragraph text. - **Bi-directional Swapping:** Instantly invert source and target languages using the swap action (`⇄`). - **Keyboard Shortcuts:** Trigger instant translation on demand using `Ctrl+Enter` (`Cmd+Enter` on macOS). - **Broad Language Support:** Full support for major technical and global languages, including English, French, Arabic, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more. --- ## Installation Clone this repository into your Antigravity plugins directory: ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/MohamedTaherBorgi/Google-Translate-for-Antigravity-Plugin.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\translator" ``` ### macOS / Linux ```bash git clone https://github.com/MohamedTaherBorgi/Google-Translate-for-Antigravity-Plugin.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/translator ``` ### Activation 1. In Antigravity, open **Customizations → Plugins**. 2. Toggle **Google Translate** (`translator`) to **Enabled**. 3. Python 3 (`python` in system PATH) is required to run the local sidecar runtime. --- ## Usage 1. Open the **Google Translate** panel from Antigravity's auxiliary side pane. 2. Select your target language (default: English). 3. Type or paste text into the input field. Translations update automatically with brief input debouncing, or upon pressing `Ctrl+Enter`. 4. Click **Copy** to place the translated output into your system clipboard. --- ## Technical Details - **Runtime:** A local lightweight HTTP server binds to loopback (`127.0.0.1`) using a dynamically assigned sidecar port. - **Privacy:** Translations are sent securely over HTTPS directly to the translation service. No conversation history, file contents, or personal identifiers are stored or forwarded to third parties. --- ## Project Structure ```text translator/ ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest ├── README.md # Documentation ├── assets/ │ └── logo.svg # Plugin icon └── sidecars/ └── translator/ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar registration configuration └── server.py # Local runtime & translation web UI ``` --- ## License MIT License. Contributions and improvements are welcome.
